manifest.name: @kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter
manifest.description: Explore source conversations in private Topics with citations, drafts, visual boards, and learning cards.
manifest.author: kirkchinese

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter/issues)

**AI 已经完成了任务，我还想弄明白它是怎么做的。**

CiteCiter 是 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件，帮助你从 Agent 的真实工作中学习。选中对话、工具结果或文档中的一段内容，在保留来源的独立 Topic 里追问，用小黑板理解关键关系，再回到原来的工作。主对话不会被改动。
[](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tqeA65EJ8/) [在 B 站观看演示](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tqeA65EJ8/)（早期版本录制，界面与当前版本略有不同）。

CiteCiter 需要 DSH 和一个可用的模型。插件声明了一个 DSH 版本范围，同一条版本线上的后续发布不需要等 CiteCiter 更新；超出范围时 DSH 会拒绝加载，请按 DSH 版本选择对应的 CiteCiter：

| DSH 版本 | CiteCiter 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上、`0.2.2` 之前（含官方桌面版，以及 `0.2.1` 的各个 alpha、rc 和正式版） | `0.9.0-beta.7` |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | `0.9.0-alpha.3` |
| `0.1.5-rc.1` | `0.8.2` |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | `0.6.0` |

**官方桌面版：** 在插件页安装 npm 包 `@kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter`，或在 Git 地址一栏填写 `https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter.git`，然后按提示重启。

**命令行与 Web：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter@0.9.0-beta.7
```

也可以从仓库安装某个发布标签，仓库内已包含构建好的插件，安装时无需构建：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter.git#v0.9.0-beta.7"
```

安装或升级后重启 DSH 并刷新页面。不要用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 强行加载与宿主版本不匹配的插件。同一个 DSH 主目录不要同时运行两个宿主进程。

例如，Agent 修改了程序，你想知道"为什么这段异步保存逻辑会影响输入？"

1. 在主对话、工具结果或文档中选中相关内容，旁边会出现 Citer 工具条。
2. 点"解释"直接得到讲解；或者点"提问"，来源和选文会作为可移除的附件放进输入框，写下自己的问题后发送。
3. 围绕这段材料继续追问；需要时让模型在小黑板上画出流程，或整理成学习卡。
4. 回到原任务，用代码、工具结果或一次小实验检查自己的理解。

新建 Topic 或选择"提问"只会准备草稿；"解释""翻译"这类预设动作在你点选时发送，也可以在设置里改成先放进输入框。解释和板书仍可能出错；它们帮助你理解和检查，不代替事实证据。

| 你想做什么 | CiteCiter 提供什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 理解一段回答、代码或工具结果 | 带来源引用的独立 Topic，追问不会写入主对话 |
| 看懂关系与过程 | 支持 Markdown、公式、表格、SVG、图片和隔离 HTML 的小黑板；支持视觉的模型可以查看渲染后的板书并自行修正；板书还能编排动画，元素按关键帧、路径或公式运动，可以播放、暂停、拖动进度和按步骤跳转 |
| 留下可回看的理解 | 可导出、可修订的学习卡，文字与代码示例分开展示 |
| 围绕真实文件讨论 | 文件与图片附件；在右侧栏阅读导入的 Markdown / 文本文档和工作区文件，选中即可提问，引用带行号并能回到原文 |
| 从理解继续动手 | 复用 DSH 的模型、工具、审批、权限、排队和插话；新 Topic 默认只读 |
| 暂停后继续 | 草稿（文字、引用、附件）和未提交的问答自动保存，切换、刷新或重启后恢复，不会自动发送 |

**工具条与动作。** 在主对话的助手回答、你自己的消息、工具结果或文档中选中文字后，旁边出现工具条：第一个动作（默认是"问 Citer"）之后是"引用"，再往后是其余前三个动作，剩下的动作和"在新 Topic 中提问"在"⋯"里。"引用"把选中的句子作为一个引用胶囊放进主对话的输入框，和 `@文件` 的样子一样，已有的文字和附件都保留；发送时主 Agent 收到这段原文和它出自谁（它的回复、你的消息或工具结果），就知道你接下来的话针对哪一句，适合和它讨论或反驳。DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 起，已发送的消息里也显示为引用胶囊。动作默认加入当前打开的 Topic，没有或已归档时新建。在 Citer 自己的回答里选中文字也会出现工具条，动作在这个 Topic 中继续，"引用"会把选段加到这个 Topic 的输入框。"问 Citer"打开输入框让你写问题；"解释""找错误""翻译"等预设动作直接发送，不会改动输入框里已有的草稿。动作的名称、提示词和顺序都可以在设置中修改。喜欢手势的话，可以在设置中开启轮盘：选中文字后按住右键（或设定的键）移向动作，松开即执行。

**右侧栏。** Citer 是 DSH 右侧栏里的一个标签页，可以从侧栏的指引页、桌宠或工具条打开，和文件、终端、其他插件的标签并排、分屏、悬浮或全屏，关闭标签即收起。更喜欢以前那种独立面板的话，在设置 → Citer → 面板中打开"不使用 DSH 右侧栏"。界面语言跟随 DSH 的语言设置（中文或英文），默认动作的名称和提示词也随之切换，你改过的动作保持原样。Topic 在输入框下方显示自己的用量：token 数、缓存命中率和上下文占用。

**文档。** 在 Citer 的空状态点"打开文档"，或在 Topic 列表的"文档"页导入 `.md` / `.txt` 文件，文档会在右侧栏的标签页里打开：Markdown 正常排版（标题、列表、代码块、公式），文本和代码带行号，长文档边滚动边显示。选中文字就会出现同样的工具条，"问 Citer""解释""引用"都可以用。从文档提问的 Topic 在引用下方显示"文档名 · 第 N 行"，点"打开原文"回到那一段并短暂高亮。工作区里的文件用 DSH 自己的文件预览打开，在视图菜单中选"Citer 阅读"即可同样选文提问，提问时会把文件快照存入 Citer 的文档。文档列表在 Topic 列表的"文档"页，可以搜索和删除；删除只移除文档本身，相关 Topic 的对话保留。不使用 DSH 右侧栏时，文档在 Citer 面板的页签里打开。

**桌宠。** Citer 收起时，她会扒在窗口边缘探头；鼠标靠近时站起来，点一下就打开 Citer。可以把她拖到左边或右边的任意高度，位置会被记住。收起期间有回答完成，或有问题在等你回答时，她旁边会出现一个小圆点。

**输入。** 输入框依次提供附件、权限模式、模型与思考强度、发送。Enter 发送，Shift + Enter 换行，输入法组词时 Enter 不会发送。生成过程中 Enter 跟随 DSH 的排队／插话设置，Ctrl + Enter 临时使用另一种方式。可以从附件菜单选择文件、粘贴图片，或把文件拖到 Citer 面板上。

**草稿。** 草稿在后台静默保存。多个窗口编辑同一个 Topic 时，各自的修改会自动合并；同一处有冲突时，以正在输入的窗口为准。发送成功后只清除已发送的部分，发送期间新写的内容会保留。

**来源与代码库。** 每个 Topic 都知道自己属于哪个主对话，即使没有引用任何内容，Citer 也能随时读取它（只能读这个主对话）。看到的是带位置标记的对话记录：用户与助手的消息、工具调用和结果；过长的工具输出先缩短，需要时再读全文。在设置中开启"自动附上来源摘录"后，每轮开头会附上来源最近的新内容，默认关闭。"代码库变化感知"在每轮开头列出上一轮以来 git 工作区（含未提交的改动）改了哪些文件，Citer 需要时再用工具读取逐行改动；也可以在设置中改为直接附上 diff，或者关闭。这些内容都记录在 Topic 里，像 DSH 主对话一样显示为可展开的上下文行，展开即是模型收到的原文；它们不会写入你的仓库。运行环境、时间等其他上下文和 DSH 一样默认不列出，可以在 Topic 菜单中选择"显示全部上下文"查看。Topic 中的工具调用也使用 DSH 的样式：读取文件带行号，编辑显示为 diff，命令显示输出和退出码。

**学习路线与学习卡。** 学习路线默认关闭，可以在 Topic 菜单（⋯）中开启；开启后，模型会根据问题用 DSH 待办安排讲解步骤。学习卡可以随时单独请求，生成前模型会核对结论、条件和计算，但自查不能保证正确。主动回忆默认关闭，开启后学习卡先显示自测问题。

**Codex Connect。** CiteCiter 适配了社区插件 [Codex Connect](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect)（`dsh-codex-connect`）。在同一个 Profile 中安装并开启它之后，Topic 可以使用它接入的 ChatGPT / Codex 模型和 GPT Image 图片工具，生成的图片直接显示在工具卡下方。图片工具需要在 Codex Connect 的设置中单独开启；它的安装、登录和支持的 DSH 版本请见该插件的说明。

新 Topic 默认**只读**，即使来源会话拥有更高权限。只有你在输入框中选择其他权限模式，或在设置里修改新 Topic 的默认权限后，Topic 才能修改工作区；DSH 的审批和沙箱规则照常生效。

Topic 只出现在 Citer 的列表里，不会出现在 DSH 的会话列表中。新 Topic 先以引用摘录或问题为标题，第一次回答时由 DSH 的标题服务生成摘要标题；双击标题、按 F2 或在 Topic 菜单中重命名，重命名后不再自动修改；归档的 Topic 在你再次发送消息后自动恢复。永久删除需要输入完整的 Session ID，只删除这个 Topic 自己的记录、草稿、附件和代码库快照。

新 Topic 使用设置中"新 Topic 的模型"，未设置时沿用来源对话输入框里当前选择的模型。如果这个模型在当前 DSH 中不可用（例如设置是在另一台机器上配置的），Topic 照常创建，引用和草稿都保留，Citer 会提示你在模型菜单中换一个可用的模型，不会自动换模型或发送。

CiteCiter 的数据保存在每个来源会话的目录中：

```text
.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<sourceSession>/
├── session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   DSH 管理的主会话（Citer 不会改动）
└── citeciter/
    ├── owner.json            目录归属

0.8 之前版本创建的 Topic 会在启动时自动迁移到这个目录，原始日志保留不动。

- Windows 上，只读模式下的 PowerShell 可能报语言模式错误或输出中文乱码。这是 DSH 执行器在只读沙箱中的限制，CiteCiter 不会为此放宽权限。
- 官方桌面版重启后，仍连接着旧后台的其他浏览器标签页可能白屏，刷新即可恢复；停用 CiteCiter 时同样会出现。
- 在同一个浏览器地址上先后使用不同版本的 DSH，宿主自己保存的草稿格式可能不兼容，导致主对话无法显示；不同版本请使用不同的地址或端口。
- 插件主要在 Windows 上测试；Linux 与 macOS 未经系统测试，遇到问题欢迎反馈。

实践通常同时产生两样东西：成果和能力。我们通过尝试、犯错、比较方案和验证，逐渐形成判断。AI 可以接手越来越多的执行，却不会自动把相应的理解交给使用者，任务完成与人的成长可能因此分离。

CiteCiter 尝试把真实的 AI 工作过程变成可引用、可追问、可检验的学习材料。从眼前的一个疑问出发，理解原理、查看证据，再带着新的认识继续工作。即使把执行交给 Agent，人仍需要提出目标、理解关键条件、判断结果是否适用，并在出现异常时接管。

欢迎带着"Agent 已经完成了，但我还讲不清"的任务来[反馈](https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter/issues)。请写明 DSH 和插件版本，以及卡在安装、引用追问还是理解回答。贴材料前请移除密钥和私人内容。

开发说明见 [CONTRIBUTING.zh.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md)，产品规则见 [docs/product.zh.md](docs/product.zh.md)。同作者的 [Claude2DSH](https://github.com/kirkchinese/claude2dsh) 用于在 Claude Code 与 DSH 之间迁移会话和资产。

**The AI finished the task. I still want to understand how it did it.**

CiteCiter is a [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that helps you learn from your agent's real work. Select part of a conversation, a tool result or a document, ask about it in a separate Topic that keeps its source, use a blackboard to see how the pieces relate, then return to your work. The main conversation is never modified.
[](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tqeA65EJ8/) [Watch the demo on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1tqeA65EJ8/) (recorded with an earlier version; the interface has changed slightly).

CiteCiter needs DSH and a working model. The plugin declares a range of DSH versions, so later releases on the same DSH line load without waiting for a CiteCiter update; outside the range DSH refuses to load it. Choose the CiteCiter release that matches your DSH:

| DSH version | CiteCiter version |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` and later, before `0.2.2` (including the official Desktop and every `0.2.1` alpha, release candidate and final release) | `0.9.0-beta.7` |
| `0.1.7-rc.2` | `0.9.0-alpha.3` |
| `0.1.5-rc.1` | `0.8.2` |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | `0.6.0` |

**Official Desktop:** install the npm package `@kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter` from the Plugins page, or enter `https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter.git` in its Git field, then restart when prompted.

**CLI and Web:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kirkchinese/dsh-citeciter@0.9.0-beta.7
```

You can also install a release tag straight from the repository, which contains the built plugin, so nothing is built at install time:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter.git#v0.9.0-beta.7"
```

Restart DSH and refresh the page after installing or upgrading. Do not use `dsh plugin allow-version` to force a plugin that does not match your host version. Do not run two host processes on the same DSH home.
Say your agent changed some code and you wonder: "Why does this async save affect typing?"

1. Select the relevant text in the conversation, a tool result or a document; the Citer toolbar appears next to it.
2. Click 解释 (explain) to get an explanation right away, or 提问 (ask) to put the source and the excerpt into the composer as removable attachments, write your own question and send it.
3. Keep asking about the material; when it helps, have the model draw the flow on the blackboard or summarize learning cards.
4. Go back to the task and check your understanding against the code, a tool result or a small experiment.

Creating a Topic or choosing 提问 only prepares a draft; preset actions such as 解释 and 翻译 send when you choose them, or only fill the composer if you change that in Settings. Explanations and boards can still be wrong; they help you understand and check, not replace evidence.

| You want to | CiteCiter provides |
| --- | --- |
| Understand an answer, code or tool result | A separate Topic with a source citation; follow-ups never touch the main conversation |
| See relationships and processes | A blackboard with Markdown, formulas, tables, SVG, images and sandboxed HTML; vision models can inspect the rendered board and fix it; board elements can be animated with keyframes, paths or formulas, and you can play, pause, scrub and step through the animation |
| Keep what you learned | Learning cards you can export and revise, with prose and code examples shown separately |
| Discuss real files | File and image attachments; read imported Markdown / text documents and workspace files in the right sidebar, select to ask, with citations that carry line numbers and lead back to the source |
| Act on what you understood | DSH models, tools, approvals, permissions, queueing and steering; new Topics are read-only by default |
| Pick up where you left off | Drafts (text, references, attachments) and unsubmitted question answers are saved and restored after switching, refreshing or restarting, never sent automatically |

**Toolbar and actions.** After you select text in an assistant answer, your own message, a tool result or a document, a toolbar appears next to it: the first action (Ask Citer by default), then Quote, then the next three actions; the rest plus "Ask in a new Topic" are under "⋯". Quote puts the selected sentences into the main conversation's composer as a quote chip that looks like an `@file` chip, keeping the text and attachments already there. When you send, the main agent receives the exact passage and who said it (its reply, your message or a tool result), so it knows which sentence your next words are about, which helps when you discuss or dispute an answer. From DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, sent messages show the quote as a chip too. Actions go to the open Topic by default, or create one when there is none or it is archived. Selecting text in Citer's own answers shows the toolbar too; the action continues that Topic, and Quote adds the passage to that Topic's composer. Ask Citer opens the composer for your own question; preset actions such as Explain, Find errors and Translate send directly without touching an existing draft. Action names, prompts and order are configurable in Settings.

**Right sidebar.** Citer is a tab in DSH's right sidebar. Open it from the sidebar's guide page, the desktop pet or the toolbar; it sits beside files, terminals and other plugins' tabs, and can be split, floated or made fullscreen like them; closing the tab closes Citer. If you prefer the standalone panel of earlier versions, turn on "Don't use DSH's right sidebar" under Settings → Citer → Panel. The interface follows DSH's language setting (Chinese or English), and so do the names and prompts of the default actions; actions you changed stay as you wrote them. Each Topic shows its own usage under the composer: tokens, cache hit rate and context occupancy.

**Documents.** Choose "Open document" in Citer's empty state, or import a `.md` / `.txt` file from the Documents page of the Topic list; the document opens as a tab in the right sidebar. Markdown is typeset (headings, lists, code blocks, math), text and code show line numbers, and long documents render as you scroll. Selecting text shows the same toolbar, so Ask Citer, Explain and Quote all work. A Topic asked from a document shows "document · line N" under its quote; "Open source" returns to that passage and briefly highlights it. Workspace files open in DSH's own file preview; choose "Citer Reading" in its view menu to select and ask the same way, and asking saves a snapshot of the file to Citer's documents. The Documents page of the Topic list searches and deletes documents; deleting removes only the document, and the Topics about it keep their conversations. Without DSH's right sidebar, documents open as a tab inside Citer's panel.

**Desktop pet.** While Citer is closed, its mascot peeks over the window edge; she stands up when the pointer comes near, and a click opens Citer. Drag her to either side at any height and the place is remembered. A small dot appears next to her when an answer finishes or a question waits for you while Citer is closed.

**Composer.** The composer offers attachments, permission mode, model and reasoning effort, and Send. Enter sends, Shift + Enter adds a line, and Enter never sends during IME composition. While a reply is generating, Enter follows DSH's queue/steer preference and Ctrl + Enter uses the other one. Add files from the attachment menu, paste images, or drop files onto the Citer panel.

**Drafts.** Drafts save silently in the background. Edits to the same Topic from several windows merge automatically; where they overlap, the window you are typing in wins. After a successful send, only what was sent is cleared, and anything written meanwhile is kept.

**Source and codebase.** Every Topic knows which main conversation it belongs to, so Citer can read it at any time, even in a Topic that quotes nothing (and only that conversation). It reads a transcript of user and assistant messages, tool calls and results, each marked with its position; long tool output is shortened first and read in full only when needed. Turn on the automatic source excerpt in Settings to add the source's newest records at the start of each turn; it is off by default. 代码库变化感知 (codebase change awareness) lists, at the start of each turn, the files that changed in the git working tree since Citer's previous turn, uncommitted changes included; Citer reads line-level diffs with a tool when they matter. Settings can attach the diffs directly or turn the notice off. Both are recorded in the Topic log and shown, like in DSH's main conversation, as expandable context rows holding the exact text the model received; your repository is never written. Other context, such as the runtime and time, stays out of the transcript as in DSH; 显示全部上下文 (show all context) in the Topic menu lists it. Tool calls in a Topic use DSH's views too: file reads with line numbers, edits as dif

**Learning route and cards.** The learning route is off by default and can be turned on in the Topic menu (⋯); when on, the model plans its explanation with DSH todos. You can ask for learning cards at any time; the model checks conclusions, conditions and calculations first, but self-checking does not guarantee correctness. Active recall is off by default; when on, cards show their self-test question first.

**Codex Connect.** CiteCiter is adapted to the community plugin [Codex Connect](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect) (`dsh-codex-connect`). With it installed and enabled in the same profile, Topics can use its ChatGPT / Codex models and GPT Image tools, and generated images appear under the tool card. Its image tools are enabled separately in Codex Connect's settings; see its documentation for installation, sign-in and supported DSH versions.

New Topics are **read-only** by default, even when the source session has more permissions. A Topic can change the workspace only after you choose another permission mode in the composer or change the default for new Topics in Settings; DSH approvals and sandboxing still apply.

Topics appear only in the Citer list, never in DSH's session list. A new Topic starts with the excerpt or question as its title, and DSH's title service summarizes it on the first answer; rename it by double-clicking the title, pressing F2 or using the Topic menu, after which the title no longer changes on its own; an archived Topic returns to the list when you send to it again. Permanent deletion asks for the full Session ID and removes only that Topic's records, drafts, attachments and codebase snapshots.

New Topics use the model for new Topics set in Settings, or, when it is unset, the model currently selected in the source conversation's composer. If that model is not available in this DSH (for example a setting made on another machine), the Topic is still created with its references and draft, and Citer asks you to pick an available model in the model menu; it never switches models or sends on its own.

CiteCiter stores its data in each source session's directory:

```text
.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<sourceSession>/
├── session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   main session managed by DSH (never modified by Citer)
└── citeciter/
    ├── owner.json            directory ownership

Topics created before 0.8 are migrated into this layout at startup; their original logs are kept.

- On Windows, PowerShell in read-only mode may report a language-mode error or print garbled Chinese. This is a limitation of the DSH executor inside the read-only sandbox; CiteCiter does not loosen permissions to work around it.
- After the official Desktop restarts, other browser tabs still connected to the old backend may go blank; refreshing restores them. This also happens with CiteCiter disabled.
- Using different DSH versions one after another at the same browser address can leave the host's own draft data in an incompatible format so the main conversation does not render; use a different address or port per version.
- The plugin is mainly tested on Windows; Linux and macOS have not been systematically tested, and reports are welcome.

Practice usually produces two things: a result and a skill. We form judgment by trying, making mistakes, comparing approaches and verifying. AI can take over more and more of the execution, but it does not automatically hand the matching understanding to its user, so finishing a task and growing as a person can come apart.

CiteCiter turns real AI work into material you can cite, question and check. Start from the question in front of you, understand the principle, look at the evidence, and continue with a better understanding. Even when an agent does the work, people still need to set goals, understand the key conditions, judge whether a result applies, and take over when something goes wrong.

Bring a task where "the agent finished, but I still can't explain it" to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/kirkchinese/CiteCiter/issues). Include your DSH and plugin versions and whether you got stuck installing, citing and asking, or understanding the answer. Remove keys and private content before pasting material.
